1418-1933-2226.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
1418-1933-2226.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Virtue of Knowledge.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Aether Adept by paying its mana cost.
When Aether Adept enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

7084-7705-8227.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
You control another nonland creature.
7084-7705-8227.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Activate Loot by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Mole Man triggers, creating a 1/1 green Minion creature token named Moloid with the listed attack trigger
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1339-2292-7920.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-2292-7920.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Tresserhorn's Lord triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

3293-4247-5282.notablePrerequisites: You have a Plains exiled by Wormfang Newt.
3293-4247-5282.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Wormfang Newt.
When Wormfang Newt dies, its second ability triggers, returning a Plains from exile to the battlefield.
When the Plains enters the battlefield, Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Resolve the Emeria Shepherd trigger, returning Wormfang Newt from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Newt enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling a Plains.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability from step 1
Repeat.

1981-2415-5231-5931.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a creature, adding {R}
When the creature dies, Funeral Room and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5686-6972-7825.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Bifur.
When Bifur dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Bifur enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.
5686-6972-7825.notes: If you have an enduring story, Bifur will trigger twice, and the other counter can be placed on whatever creature you desire.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

1778-3558-4668-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
1778-3558-4668-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

3490-4659-5929-7665.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
3490-4659-5929-7665.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters as a Hero due to Leyline of Transformation, Captain America triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and the Servo.
Animation Module triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the first Animation Module trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the second Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

4499-5999-7494.description:
Cast a copy of Seething Song from exile by paying no more than {1}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Blazing Firesinger, which enters prepared.
Repeat.

640-2263-7275.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or greater.
640-2263-7275.description:
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Geralf's Mindcrusher.
Geralf's Mindcrusher dies due to having 0 toughness, triggering its undying ability and Dross Harvester
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Geralf's Mindcrusher trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Mindcrusher enters, it triggers, causing a player to mill five cards.
Resolve the Champion of the Weird ability from step 1, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Geralf's Mindcrusher, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Repeat.

240-5147-5223-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat from step 2.

3000-4231-4321-5776-5777.description:
Activate Chatterfang by paying {B} and sacrificing a Squirrel.
Because the Squirrel is a Food due to Ygra, when it dies, Camellia and Ygra trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Camellia trigger, creating five 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens, a Food, a Clue and a Treasure token
Resolve the Chatterfang ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
3000-4231-4321-5776-5777.notes: You can target Ygra with Chatterfang's ability infinitely. Since it gets +2/+2 each loop, it won't die from its toughness reduction.

372-961-6927.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Against All Odds exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-961-6927.description:
Cast Against All Odds by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Damage Control Crew and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Damage Control Crew trigger.
Resolve the Damage Control Crew trigger, returning Against All Odds from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Against All Odds.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Damage Control Crew and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

522-1429-3698.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Melira.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

3284-4550-4871-6798.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
3284-4550-4871-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another creature.
Korvold's second ability and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Korvold trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Korvold's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat.

813-6103-6492-6568.description:
Cast Illusion of Choice by paying {U}, allowing you to decide how each player votes this turn and causing you to draw a a card.
Cast Plea for Power by paying {3}{U}, choosing all votes to be for time, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Y'shtola Rhul triggers, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Illusion of Choice and Plea for Power from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1563-2457-4068-4772.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
1563-2457-4068-4772.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

560-2292-2425-4550.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-2292-2425-4550.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Smothering Abomination triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve both Viscera Seer abilities.
Repeat.

880-4862-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-4862-4871.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, and Omnath triggers if the creature was an Elemental.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Omnath trigger, if applicable, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Resolve the Perilous Forays ability, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Omnath triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1766-1978-4241.description:
Animate Thran Dynamo using Karn.
Activate Thran Dynamo by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Thran Dynamo.
Repeat from step 2.

1636-3143-4704.notablePrerequisites:
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
Saproling Burst has at least two fade counters on it.
1636-3143-4704.description:
Activate Saproling Burst by removing a fade counter from it, creating a */* Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Xavier Sal's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing the Saproling, putting a fade counter on Saproling Burst.
Repeat.

947-1132-1305-2557.description:
Cast Heaven Sent by paying {U}{R}.
Widespread Thieving triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{R}.
Resolve Heaven Sent, choosing to have it enter the battlefield with three chapter counters on it due to its read ahead ability.
Heaven Sent's third chapter ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent, and causing you to draw seven cards if an opponent has 0 or less life, or otherwise exile Heaven Sent with the ability to play it this turn.
If Heaven Sent was exiled this way, repeat until Heaven Sent is not exiled.

719-1520-1806-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
When Eternal Scourge dies as a Vampire due to Xenograft, Timothar triggers, causing you to pay {1} and exile Eternal Scourge to create a 1/1 Bat creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Bat, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Repeat.

1462-2929-3147.description:
Play Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield as an enchantment due to Enchanted Evening, it and Composer of Spring trigger.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Composer of Spring trigger, putting Azorius Chancery onto the battlefield from your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2249-5189.notablePrerequisites: Ghave has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
2034-2249-5189.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
When the Saproling dies, Death's Presence triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Ghave.
Repeat.

4067-5244.easyPrerequisites: You've created a token this turn.
4067-5244.description:
Activate Idol of Oblivion by tapping it, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Idol of Oblivion.
Repeat.
